goal: Use retaliation against five incoming hits while preserving leader pressure.
guidance: This turn has 19 incoming across five hits. Flame Barrier gives 15 block, Plating adds 2, and retaliation deals 12 to Priest plus 8 to its attacking follower. With the last energy, Setup Strike gives 7 leader damage despite Weak, better than an ordinary Strike. Prefer this mixed line over pure defense or three attacks. Temporary Strength is not useful after ending the turn, but Setup Strike is still the strongest remaining one-energy attack. Expected HP loss is only 2 if these blocks are used.
